objective: Replace full vocabulary PCIe/CPU greedy scans with generic device reduction over exact blocked BF16 logits; root owns output-policy/Generation wiring.
semantics: Finite values ordered by exact BF16-derived signed integer key, preserving+0>-0 and lowest token-ID ties. Arbitrary per-row packed bans; all-banned falls back to unmasked argmax. Any nonfinite code explicitly returns fallback flag for original CPU sampler, including +/-Inf and anyNaN.
inputs: BlockedLogits; ban_words:i32[W/32,R64] 2MiB with1meaningbanned; fixed negative tokenIDs:i32[W], bit positions:i32[W%32].
result: i32[R64,GreedyField=8], fields0maskedmax(-65536 iff all banned),1masked negativeID,2unmasked negativeID,3maxabsBF16code(>=0x7f80 requiresCPUfallback); fields4..7unused.
mechanism: Two-stage signed-key max then negative-ID max, no34-bit packing. Two16-query groups per cluster; one-query mask and winner tiles. Whole logits32MiB read onNPU,2MiB packed arbitrary bans,2KiB result onCPU.
validation: Nonzero all64 row CPU total_cmp reference, arbitrary dense/sparse masks, allbanned, exactties/lowestID, signedzero, finite BF16 extremes/subnormals, nonfinite fallback flags. Warm kernel and small-result PCIe timing. No benchmark/input specialization; root dispatch only.
compile_repairs: I32 intra max requires Way4 then pad back to Way8.
Ban word HBM load retains query packet; TU scalar-padded transpose and VRF broadcast avoid illegal 4-byte scalar TDMA broadcasts.
A single LogicBitOr Mode11 initializes the word stream, avoiding duplicate BitAnd hardware use.
Two 16-query groups per cluster bound simultaneous key/candidate DM temporaries.
One-query mask/ID tiles keep live VRF below 8KiB, including overlapping operands.
